name: sun
description: Generate podcasts, guided meditations, bedtime stories and original songs with SUN.

interface.longDescription: Ask SUN to turn any topic into a podcast, or into something to listen to: a guided meditation for sleep, calm or focus, a bedtime story told in chapters, or an original song. Give a podcast a subject and a length or attach files, and SUN writes and narrates a multi-episode course, for example "Make me a 20 minute podcast on the Cuban Missile Crisis". Pick one of SUN's voices, SUN's characters, or your own voice cloned in the SUN app, so a story can be read to your child in your voice. Listen as soon as the first part is ready. You can also schedule recurring audio briefings that arrive in the SUN app.
defaultPrompt: Make me a 10 minute sleep meditation
Read my son a bedtime story about a brave little rabbit in my own voice
Write a song about my dog Max
